alternative_explanations: The spectral bigram fit may collapse to an ordinary low-rank finite-state predictor, making contraction depth the only favorable signature.
Exact marginalization may require enough total work that a sequential classical control Pareto-dominates it despite logarithmic dependency depth.
confounds: The locally visible code corpus is screening evidence and exact-span accuracy may remain zero for all implementable models.
Floating-point association order can create sub-1e-10 probability differences even when the mathematical tensor is identical.
falsification_criteria: Discard if learned parallel and sequential differ in any cell by more than 1e-10 on bits per byte, accuracy or exact-span accuracy.
Discard if learned parallel improves bits per byte over frozen by less than 0.05 or reduces overall accuracy or exact-span accuracy.
Discard unless parallel critical path is strictly lower at spans 32 and 128, its three-span slope is below 0.5 and sequential slope is above 0.8.
Discard if a complete implementable control Pareto-dominates learned parallel on frozen quality, work, critical-path and state axes.

Invalidate on source-identity mismatch, hidden sequential contraction, target leakage, within-round dependency, post-score tuning, omitted cost, semantic-baseline, preflight, evaluator or integrity failure.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus mismatch or overlap with the EXP-0044 corpus.
Invalidate if a public query exposes a path, target byte, uncorrupted span or future refinement snapshot.
Invalidate if predictions within one round observe another prediction from that same round.
Invalidate if candidate critical-path work is sequentially hidden inside a declared simultaneous step.

Invalidate if the three Born-MPS roles differ in token representation, tensor rank, initialization, training data/order, update count or output probabilities beyond the preregistered contraction-schedule and tensor-learning interventions.
Invalidate if the parallel role hides a sequential contraction inside its declared critical path or if the sequential role reports tree-contraction depth.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, seed leakage, byte-permutation leakage or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify the exact rule, preserve the logarithmic-depth diagnostic if present, and return to breadth without tuning.
outcome_policy.null: Mark the exact rank-2 spectral Born rule unsupported and stop without changing rank, smoothing, fit or contraction.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep HYP-0037 at testing confidence and preregister only an unchanged three-seed new-corpus replication; do not promote.
